anchors.anchor_seat: seat cushion top centre (operator hip point), child of body; face +Z

sides: L/R are the vehicle's own left/right: L = +X, R = -X (vehicle faces +Z)
hierarchy: forklift_counterbalance > body > {beacon, wheel_FL, wheel_FR, steer_RL > wheel_RL, steer_RR > wheel_RR, mast_tilt > mast_outer > mast_inner > fork_carriage > {fork_L, fork_R}}

rig.drive: move/rotate body (or root); front axle (drive, y=-0.45 m in Blender = z +0.45 in glTF) is the fixed axle, rear axle steers (wheelbase 1.27 m)
rig.steer: rotate steer_RL/steer_RR about local Y, up to +-75 deg (rear-steer: positive yaw turns the truck the opposite way)
rig.spin: rotate wheel_* about local X; front r=0.32 m, rear r=0.26 m
rig.tilt: rotate mast_tilt about local X: about -3 deg (forward) .. +6 deg (back)
rig.lift: stage 1: translate fork_carriage +Y 0..1.0 m inside mast_inner (free lift); stage 2: translate mast_inner +Y 0..1.9 m (carriage rides along). Max fork height ~3.0 m

nodes.body: static chassis, counterweight, overhead guard, seat, LPG tank; parent of all moving parts
nodes.mast_tilt: Empty at the mast base hinge (x=0, y=0.12 m, z=+0.84 m glTF); rotate about X to tilt; parents mast_outer
nodes.steer_RL/steer_RR: Empty on each rear kingpin (x=+-0.33, axle height 0.26 m); rotate about Y to steer; parent of wheel_RL/RR
nodes.beacon: emissive orange dome, origin at its base on the rear roof rail (blink / scale)
nodes.wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR: origin exactly at axle centre, spin about local X (RL/RR are children of steer_RL/RR)
nodes.mast_outer: child of mast_tilt, origin coincident with the tilt hinge; fixed outer stage
nodes.mast_inner: child of mast_outer, origin at its base; translate +Y up to ~1.9 m (telescoping stage)
nodes.fork_carriage: child of mast_inner, origin at carriage bottom; translate +Y (lift)
nodes.fork_L/fork_R: children of fork_carriage, origin at fork heel; translate X for side-shift / spread
